headline: UK Inflation Rises to 3.6% in October
summary: UK inflation reached 3.6% in the year to October, driven primarily by higher petrol and diesel prices.
why: Inflation data is a key indicator for central bank policy and consumer purchasing power, influencing interest rate decisions and market sentiment regarding the UK economy.

impacts.name: FTSE 100
impacts.why: Higher-than-expected inflation often leads to expectations of tighter monetary policy, which can weigh on equity markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Inflation data directly impacts expectations for central bank interest rate policy, which is a primary driver of bond yields and equity market performance.
